findings.obs_text: Discerning and understanding stand with the thoughts in 1Ch 28:9, Psa 139:2, Heb 4:12 and Mic 4:12: the Lord understands every plan and discerns the thoughts from afar, the word discerns the thoughts of the heart, and the nations do not understand the Lord's plan. In Psa 73:16 the psalmist's thinking how to understand wearies him.
findings.grounds: you discern my thoughts from afar

findings.obs_text: Wisdom and folly in thought: in Pro 14:15 the prudent gives thought to his steps, in Pro 18:2 the fool prefers airing his opinion to understanding, in 1Cor 3:18 the one who thinks himself wise must become a fool, and in 1Cor 3:20 the reasonings of the clever are futile before the Lord. In Ecc 9:10 there is no thought or wisdom in Sheol, in Dan 2:30 Daniel disclaims any wisdom of his own, in 2Sa 14:17 the king discerns good and evil, and in 1Cor 7:40 Paul gives his judgment.
findings.grounds: the prudent gives thought to his steps

findings.obs_text: In Jos 22:28 the tribes thought the altar would be a witness between them and their descendants: the thought looks ahead to a later dispute. In Mat 15:19 false witness comes out of the heart with evil thoughts, and in Joh 5:39 the Scriptures that the hearers think hold life bear witness to Jesus.
findings.grounds: it is they that bear witness about me
